description: Sort boards newest-first and PRD kanban items by relevant timestamps across the Ralfie dashboard UI

items.user_story: As a user, I see boards sorted newest-first on the BoardList page so I can quickly find my most recent work
items.description: Sort boards by created_at descending on the BoardList page
items.end_state: BoardListPage renders boards in descending created_at order. A board created today appears before one created yesterday.
steps_to_verify: Open the BoardList page in the browser
Confirm boards are ordered from most recently created to oldest
Verify the sort uses meta.created_at, not alphabetical or filesystem order

items.user_story: As a user, I see boards sorted newest-first on the Dashboard so the most recent boards are prominent
items.description: Sort boards by created_at descending on the Dashboard page
items.end_state: DashboardPage renders boards in descending created_at order, matching the BoardList sort behavior.
steps_to_verify: Open the Dashboard page in the browser
Confirm boards are ordered from most recently created to oldest

items.user_story: As a user, I see in-progress, done, and verified items sorted by most recent activity so I can track what changed last
items.description: Sort PRD kanban columns: In Progress by started_at desc, Done by completed_at desc, Verified by completed_at desc. Pending and Failed remain in array order. Null timestamps sort to the bottom.
items.end_state: PrdKanban component sorts In Progress items by started_at newest-first, Done items by completed_at newest-first, Verified items by completed_at newest-first. Pending and Failed columns keep their original array order. Items with null timestamps appear at the bottom of their column.
steps_to_verify: Open a board detail page with items in multiple statuses
Confirm In Progress column shows most recently started items first
Confirm Done column shows most recently completed items first
Confirm Verified column shows most recently completed items first
Confirm Pending and Failed columns are unchanged from array order
Confirm items with null timestamps appear at the bottom of sorted columns
